description: Curated source catalogue for Architecture as Code GitHub issue drafts. Each entry documents an authoritative reference used in the manuscript.

sources.title: Architecture as Code: What is CALM?
sources.summary: FINOS Architecture as Code project page introducing the Common Architecture Language Model (CALM): architecture expressed in a human- and machine-readable form that tooling can validate automatically (undated web page, accessed 30 October 2026).

sources.title: Security policy as code – Thoughtworks Technology Radar
sources.summary: Technology Radar technique (Trial in Vol. 21, November 2019; Adopt in Vol. 23, October 2020) describing security policies expressed as code, version-controlled, automatically validated, deployed and monitored, with Open Policy Agent and Istio as examples.

sources.title: Comparing Workflows
sources.summary: Atlassian Git tutorial comparing centralised, feature-branch, Gitflow and forking workflows; cited for the branching strategies applied to architecture repositories (undated page, accessed 30 October 2026).

sources.title: About protected branches
sources.summary: GitHub documentation explaining branch protection rules, required status checks, and review requirements for controlled merges.

sources.title: What is Terraform?
sources.summary: HashiCorp's introduction to Terraform, covering declarative configuration, the plan and apply cycle, and state management fundamentals (undated documentation page, accessed 30 October 2026).

sources.title: CNCF Cloud Native Definition v1.1
sources.summary: CNCF Technical Oversight Committee's canonical definition of cloud native technologies (v1.1, approved 26 February 2024), covering containers, microservices, and dynamic orchestration.

sources.title: State of Cloud Native Development Q3 2025
sources.summary: SlashData survey for CNCF (November 2025) of backend developers: 46 % use microservices, 27 % use event-driven architecture, and use of internal developer platforms rose from 23 % (Q3 2024) to 27 % (Q3 2025).

sources.title: The Site Reliability Workbook: Practical Ways to Implement SRE
sources.summary: O'Reilly workbook edited by Beyer, Murphy, Rensin, Kawahara and Thorne (ISBN 978-1-492-02950-2) providing practical guidance on reliability engineering, error budgets, and automation-first operations.

sources.title: AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK) v2 Developer Guide
sources.summary: Amazon's official CDK guide covering infrastructure-as-code patterns using familiar programming languages to define and provision AWS resources, including CI/CD with CDK Pipelines.

sources.title: Open Policy Agent documentation
sources.summary: Open Policy Agent project documentation (landing page "Open Policy Agent (OPA)") covering the Rego policy language, admission control patterns, and integration with CI/CD pipelines (accessed 30 October 2026).

sources.title: Security and Privacy Controls for Information Systems and Organizations – NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5
sources.summary: NIST catalogue of security and privacy controls (Revision 5, September 2020, updated 10 December 2020) providing a framework for implementing and assessing control effectiveness in information systems.

sources.title: Define approvals and checks
sources.summary: Microsoft Learn article (page title "Pipeline deployment approvals", updated 29 August 2024) explaining that approvals and checks are configured on resources such as environments and service connections by resource administrators, not in pipeline YAML.

sources.title: Kubernetes Documentation: Concepts
sources.summary: Kubernetes project documentation covering cluster architecture, workload management, services, and configuration primitives.

sources.title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 – Information security, cybersecurity and privacy protection — Information security management systems — Requirements
sources.summary: International standard (third edition, October 2022) specifying requirements for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving an information security management system; Annex A uses the 2022 control numbering.

sources.title: Testing Pulumi programs
sources.summary: Pulumi IaC documentation page "Testing" (heading "Testing Pulumi programs") covering unit tests with mocks (pulumi.runtime.setMocks / set_mocks / Pulumi.Testing), property tests and integration tests (accessed 30 October 2026).

sources.title: Manage sensitive data in your configuration
sources.summary: Terraform documentation on handling sensitive values and state; the former page "Sensitive data in state" (…/language/state/sensitive-data) redirects here. The same document is Source [20] in the bibliography (accessed 30 October 2026).
